svg.title: Two identical baskets sell under different terms as Cecil compares them.
svg.desc: Two equal baskets of produce sit under different blank slates. One customer receives quiet credit while another pays immediately, and Riju notes that one price includes time.
svg.text: Page 13, panel 2 · Counter-height medium shot across two sales of the same produce

text.tspan: Riju sees the same goods sold under different terms
for reasons the transaction record omits.
